plugins.name: Funscript devices
plugins.description: Plays the .funscript next to a video on devices connected to Intiface Central
plugins.summary: Moves your toys in sync with the video, from a .funscript file
about: Many videos come with a **.funscript** file: a script of movements timed to the video. This plugin plays it on devices connected to **Intiface Central** (strokers, vibrators, rotators), in sync with what you watch - local files, network shares, **Plex** and **Jellyfin**.
howto: Install **Intiface Central** (intiface.com) on your PC or phone, start its server and connect your devices.
Turn this plugin on, then press **Find Intiface on the network** on its page.
Put the script next to the video with the same name (Film.mp4 + Film.funscript), or into **.local/share/pixelvr/Funscripts** in your home folder - that also works for Plex and Jellyfin.
Play the video. Devices pause while you scrub, pause or take the headset off.

0.2.6: The Funscripts folder moved to **.local/share/pixelvr/Funscripts** in your home folder, so the home folder stays tidy. Scripts from the old folder are moved automatically.
0.2.5: Scripts for **Plex** and **Jellyfin** videos: put them in the new **Funscripts** folder (in your home folder, subfolders work too), named like the video file or its title.
0.2.4: The "Script" bar above the control panel is gone (it was for testing).
0.2.3: Broken script files can no longer send invalid values to devices.
0.2.2: Explains when Intiface refuses because another app is connected to it.
0.2.1: Resumes by itself after the connection to Intiface drops.
0.2.0: Devices fade out while you scrub and glide back in afterwards.
New setting: While scrubbing - Stop or Keep running.

plugins.name: Sync with MultiFunPlayer / XBVR (DeoVR protocol)
plugins.description: Only needed if MultiFunPlayer, ScriptPlayer or XBVR controls your devices
plugins.summary: Lets MultiFunPlayer, ScriptPlayer or XBVR follow your video
about: Only needed if you already control your devices from **MultiFunPlayer**, **ScriptPlayer**, **FunFlixDroid** or **XBVR** on another device. Those apps then follow the video playing in Pixel VR Player, the same way they follow DeoVR.
howto: Turn this plugin on. Its status line shows the address to enter, e.g. 192.168.1.20 port 23554.
In MultiFunPlayer add a "DeoVR" source with that address (ScriptPlayer / XBVR: the DeoVR option).
Play a video on the selected screen: the app shows it and plays its script.
Use either this or the Funscript devices plugin, not both: Intiface accepts only one app.

0.1.2: New name and description that explain what it is for.
0.1.1: No more jump to 0:00 right after a video opens.
